text:
maria: Quick question — I'm tuning the latency alerts for model-serving-prod. Where do people normally pull request_latency_p95 and traces?

jonathan: Grafana -> Model Serving cluster -> Latency dashboard. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/model-serving/latency (bookmark this). p95 is under panel 'request_latency_p95'.

maria: thanks. I'm seeing a lot of P95 spikes around 11:30-12:00 UTC, want to avoid paging for noisy transient blips.

jonathan: If it's short-lived, we usually: 1) set alert for sustained over 3m, 2) set severity=warning for p95 between 200-400ms, critical above 800ms. Also enable 'suppression windows' for deploy hours if it's rollout noise.

ashley: runbook is ops-runbooks/redwood-model-serving (internal Confluence). Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Model+Serving+Runbook. It has the triage checklist: logs -> traces -> recent deploys -> restart pod.

maria: where do I find the traces (Jaeger?) and request-level logs quickly?

jonathan: Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=model-server. For logs: short one-liners: 
```
kubectl -n model-serving logs -l app=model-server --since=1h | grep -i latency
```
Or use Loki: https://loki.redwood.ai/explore?orgId=1&left=... with query `{app="model-server"}` and `|~ "latency"`

derek: small PD routing q — which PagerDuty service do these alerts map to? We need to know if oncall should be paged or just slack.

jonathan: Current mapping: alert name prefix `model-serving-*` -> PagerDuty service `model-serving-prod` (SRE rotation). Slack channel is #model-serving-alerts with automatic summary. We can change severity mapping in the PD service.

derek: can you paste the PD config snippet? helps me update the docs.

jonathan: Sure, example config we use in our alert-manager routing: 
```
receivers:
  - name: 'pagerduty-model-serving'
    pagerduty_configs:
      - service_key: 'PD_MODEL_SERVING_KEY'
        severity: '{{ if gt .Labels.p95 800 }}critical{{ else }}warning{{ end }}'
route:
  receiver: 'pagerduty-model-serving'
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 3h
  match_re:
    alertname: 'model-serving-.*'
```
(we keep group_wait short but group_interval to dedupe bursts)

maria: ok. For my change, I'll propose: only send to PD if p95 > 800ms for >=5min OR error_rate > 0.5% for >=3m. Otherwise send to slack as warning.

ashley: sounds good. Can you also add a short note in runbook about who the metric owner is? Right now ownership is unclear.

maria: yes — propose owner = @ashley for latency alerts, contact = #platform-slo. I'll update PR.

derek: one more — if PD pages SRE, what's the fallback if nobody acknowledges in 15m? escalation policy?

jonathan: PD escalation: initial -> SRE rotation (5m), then team lead (15m), then eng-ops exec (30m). We can adjust windows but it's pretty standard. If you want different path for this service (e.g., page product infra instead of SRE), open a ticket with PD team.

maria: thanks. I'll open PR with the updated Prometheus alert rule and a runbook blurb. PR will include the thresholds and the PD routing change (warning->slack, critical->PD).

oncall-bot: PagerDuty mapping check: service `model-serving-prod` currently has escalation policy `sre-oncall`. No recent changes in last 90d. :white_check_mark:

ashley: @maria great — can you assign me as owner in the PR? I'll take care of the runbook and add play-by-play steps and command snippets.

maria: done — PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/723. Includes alert rule, example test triggers, and runbook updates.

derek: I'll skim and give a 👍 or request changes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
